list.title: Entities
list.intro: Each entity has its own address, branding and configuration.
list.caption: List of entities
list.emptyDelegated: No entity is attached to your account. Contact a super administrator.

name.label: Entity name
name.hint: Shown on the public pages and in the emails. At most 100 characters.

fqdn.label: Address (FQDN)
fqdn.hint: Fully qualified domain name of the public pages of the entity, for example transfer.entity-a.example.com. It must point to the reverse proxy.
fqdn.taken: This address is already used by another entity.
fqdn.reserved: This address is reserved for the administration and cannot be given to an entity.

defaultLanguage.label: Default language
defaultLanguage.hint: Used when the browser language is not available, and for the emails.

storageQuota.label: Storage quota
storageQuota.hint: Total space the transfers of the entity may use. New deposits are blocked when it is reached.

maxTransfer.label: Maximum size per transfer
maxTransfer.hint: Total of the files of a transfer. At most 20 GB.
maxTransfer.hintCeiling: Total of the files of a transfer. At most {ceiling}, the ceiling set by the super administrator.
maxTransfer.aboveCeiling: The size cannot exceed the ceiling of {ceiling}.
maxTransfer.followsCeiling: Total of the files of a transfer. It will be lowered to the new ceiling of {ceiling} when you save.

maxTransferCeiling.label: Ceiling of the size per transfer
maxTransferCeiling.hint: Largest value the delegated administrators may choose for the size per transfer. Lowering it below the current size lowers that size too.

create.title: Create an entity
create.intro: The other settings (branding, network, mail, templates) are configured once the entity is created.

background.hint: The image shown behind the public pages. You can change it later in Branding; an uploaded image takes precedence over this choice.
background.loadError: The background images could not be loaded. The entity will be created with the default background; you can change it later in Branding.

delegated.enableHint: Optional. The administrator is attached to this entity only and receives an activation link, valid 72 hours.
delegated.conflict: An entity or an administrator already exists with this data: check the domain name (FQDN) of the entity and the username of the administrator. Nothing has been created.

general.title: General
general.delegatedNote: A delegated administrator can only change the default language and the maximum size per transfer. The other settings are managed by the super administrator.
general.saved: The general settings have been saved.
general.deletingBanner: This entity is being deleted. The deletion resumes automatically if it was interrupted.

delete.title: Delete the entity
delete.text: Deletion permanently erases every transfer, file, verified address, invitation, API token and setting of the entity. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmText: Every transfer and all the data of the entity will be permanently erased. Files already backed up will become unreadable.
delete.resumes: The deletion could not be completed. It will resume automatically: until then, the entity stays marked as “deletion in progress”.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: Content of the alerts sent to the webhooks of the entity.

includeAddresses.label: Include addresses in webhooks
includeAddresses.hint: Adds the sender and recipient addresses concerned to the alerts. Addresses are personal data and leave TransTeira with the alert: enable only if the receivers need them and are trusted. Off by default.

antivirus.title: Antivirus analysis
antivirus.statusEnabled: Files of this entity are analysed by the antivirus.
antivirus.statusDisabled: The antivirus analysis is disabled for this entity: files finalised now are delivered unscanned and flagged as such.
antivirus.statusDisabledDelegated: The antivirus analysis is disabled for this entity by the super admin: files are delivered unscanned and flagged as such. Only the super admin can change this.
antivirus.statusEnabledDelegated: The antivirus analysis is enabled for this entity. Only the super admin can change this.
antivirus.instanceNote: The antivirus is disabled for the whole instance by the operator (TT_ANTIVIRUS_ENGINE=none): no file is analysed, whatever this setting.
antivirus.confirmText: Files finalised from now on are delivered without analysis and flagged "not analysed: antivirus disabled" for the sender and the recipients. Files already waiting for the analysis keep waiting. Enabling the antivirus again never rescans past files.

general.auditorNote: You have read-only access to this entity: the settings below cannot be changed.

export.title: Exporting the configuration
export.intro: Downloads the configuration of the entity as a JSON file, to create another entity the same way (the super admin’s "Duplicate" or "Import a configuration" actions).

includeBranding.label: Include the logo and the background image
includeBranding.hint: Adds the image files to the exported file, which then gets larger. Without it, only the colors and the choice of a library image are exported.

export.notice: The file contains personal data (addresses of the blocklist, contacts in the legal texts): keep it carefully. It never contains a secret: no SMTP password, no webhook URL, no single sign-on setting, no API token. Webhooks must be entered again after the import.

linkOnly.title: Link-only transfers
linkOnly.intro: A link-only transfer sends no mail to the recipients: the sender gets the link once and passes it on themselves (instant messaging, for example).
linkOnly.label: Allow link-only transfers
linkOnly.hint: Each confidentiality level can still forbid them. Off by default.
linkOnly.statusOn: Link-only transfers are allowed for this entity (set by the super admin).
linkOnly.statusOff: Link-only transfers are not allowed for this entity (set by the super admin).

e2e.title: End-to-end encryption
e2e.intro: When allowed, senders can encrypt their files in the browser: the key stays in the link and the server can never read them.
e2e.label: End-to-end encryption policy
e2e.hint: Forbidden by default. Required means that no file of this entity is analysed by the antivirus, since the server cannot read it. Each confidentiality level can only tighten this policy.
e2e.status: End-to-end encryption policy of this entity (set by the super admin): {policy}.

branding.title: Branding
branding.intro: Logo, colors and background image of the public pages of the entity.

colors.title: Colors
colors.invalid: Enter a color in the #RRGGBB format.

contrast.title: Contrast
contrast.intro: The contrast ratio must reach at least 4.5:1 (level AA) for the texts to stay readable (RGAA).
contrast.warning: At least one color does not offer sufficient contrast. The texts may be hard to read. You can still save.
contrast.darkNote: In the dark theme, a color that does not reach the required contrast on the dark background is not used for links or the focus indicator: the accessible default colors of the dark theme replace it, and the accent color is only decorative, so readability is preserved.
contrast.serverNote: The server check, shown after saving, is authoritative.

preview.label: Preview of the public page
preview.heading: Send files
preview.text: Drop your files and share them securely.

image.deleteConfirmText: The image will be removed from the public pages of the entity.
image.types: Accepted formats: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Maximum size: {size}.
image.badType: This format is not accepted. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
image.tooLarge: The image exceeds the maximum size of {size}.
image.tooLargeServer: The image file or its dimensions are too large.
image.unsupportedServer: The server did not recognize this file as a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: Shown at the top of the public pages.

background.title: Background image
background.hint: Shown full screen behind the deposit area. Without an image, the default image is used.

library.title: Background library
library.intro: Choose one of the images supplied with TransTeira as the background of the public pages.
library.customNote: A background image uploaded above takes precedence over this choice.
library.customActive: A custom background image is uploaded: the choice below will only apply once it has been removed.
library.saved: The background image has been applied.

network.title: Network
network.intro: A user is internal when their IP address belongs to a range below and their email address belongs to a domain below. Only internal users can deposit freely and send invitations.

cidrs.label: Internal IP address ranges
cidrs.hint: One range per line, in CIDR notation, for example 192.0.2.0/24 or 2001:db8::/32.

domains.label: Internal email domains
domains.hint: One domain per line, for example entity-a.example.com.

cidr.syntax: Not a valid IP address or CIDR range (for example 192.0.2.0/24 or 2001:db8::/32).
cidr.zone: IPv6 zone identifiers (%…) are not allowed.
cidr.prefixRange: The prefix length is too large: at most /32 for IPv4 and /128 for IPv6.
cidr.hostBits: The address has host bits set: enter the network address of the range.
cidr.hostBitsSuggestion: The address has host bits set: the matching range is {network}.

domain.syntax: Not a valid domain name: enter the domain alone, without spaces, @, :, / or brackets.
domain.ipLiteral: An IP address is not a mail domain.
domain.idn: This international domain name cannot be converted to its ASCII (punycode) form.
domain.tooLong: The domain name is longer than 253 characters.
domain.singleLabel: The domain must contain at least one dot, for example example.com.
domain.label: Each part of the domain may contain only letters, digits and inner hyphens, 63 characters at most.
domain.tld: The last part of the domain (top-level domain) must have at least two letters.

warnings.emptyCidrs: No IP range: nobody will be considered internal, and only invitations will allow deposits.
warnings.emptyDomains: No domain: nobody will be considered internal, and only invitations will allow deposits.
warnings.catchAll: The range {range} covers every IP address: any user of an internal domain will be able to deposit from anywhere.

network.saved: The network settings have been saved.
network.normalized: The server normalized some values. The lists shown are the saved ones.

remote.title: Deposit from outside
remote.intro: To ease remote work, let internal users deposit from outside the IP ranges of the entity.
remote.label: Allow deposits from outside for already verified internal users
remote.hint: Off by default. Only for addresses of an internal domain already verified once from the internal network. From outside, a verification code is asked at each deposit, and these deposits are flagged in the audit log. Invitations remain reserved to users connected from the internal network.

reply.title: Reply to a transfer
reply.intro: Let the recipients of a transfer send files back to its sender from the download page.
reply.label: Allow recipients to reply to a transfer
reply.hint: Off by default. A reply is only possible for a transfer sent by an internal user to a recipient with a personal link, and the recipient always proves their address by a verification code first. Replies are subject to the quotas and the abuse detection of external users, and to the antivirus. Turning the option off stops new replies at once.

review.title: Imported ranges and domains to confirm
review.text: These ranges and domains were imported: check them, then confirm. Until they are confirmed, the setup cannot be completed.
review.dirty: Save your changes: saving also confirms them.
review.confirmed: The internal ranges and domains are confirmed.

smtp.title: Mail (SMTP)
smtp.intro: Server through which the entity sends its emails (verification codes, notifications, invitations, alerts).
smtp.notConfigured: Mail is not configured yet: the entity cannot send any email.

host.label: SMTP server
host.hint: Host name or IP address, for example smtp.example.com or smtp-relay.

security.label: Connection security
security.noneHint: No encryption: only for a relay reachable through the internal Docker network alone.

username.label: Username
username.hint: Leave empty for a relay without authentication.
username.requiredWithPassword: Enter the username that goes with the password.
username.needsSecurity: Authentication requires STARTTLS or TLS: choose one of them, or remove the username.

password.label: Password
password.reenter: The server, port or username has changed: enter the password again, or remove it.
password.encrypted: The password is encrypted in the database and never shown again.

fromAddress.label: Sender address
fromAddress.hint: Address used in the “From” field of the emails, for example transfer@entity-a.example.com.

fromName.label: Sender name
fromName.hint: Optional. Defaults to the name of the entity.

warnings.credentialsOverNone: Authentication is refused without encryption: the credentials would travel in clear. Choose STARTTLS or TLS, or remove the username for a relay without authentication.

smtp.saved: The SMTP settings have been saved.

test.title: Test email
test.intro: Sends a test email with the saved settings. Save your changes first.

to.label: Recipient address
to.hint: The address that will receive the test email.

test.success: The test email was accepted by the server in {duration} ms.
test.failure: The test email could not be sent.

rateLimited.one: Too many test emails. Try again in {count} second.
rateLimited.other: Too many test emails. Try again in {count} seconds.

dns.title: DNS check (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
dns.intro: Indicative check of the DNS records of the sender address domain. Without them, the emails may be classified as spam.

selectors.label: DKIM selectors
selectors.hint: Selectors cannot be discovered automatically: enter up to 5, separated by commas (for example selector1, selector2 for Microsoft 365).

dns.notConfigured: Save a sender address first to check its domain.

templates.title: Email templates
templates.intro: Customize the emails sent by the entity, for each language. A template that is not customized uses the default text.
templates.caption: Email templates

keyDescription.verification-code: Sent to the sender to verify their address.
keyDescription.transfer-notification: Sent to the recipients with the download link.
keyDescription.transfer-confirmation: Sent to the sender once the transfer is available.
keyDescription.first-download: Sent to the sender at the first download.
keyDescription.file-problems: Sent to the sender when a file is infected or withheld.
keyDescription.file-not-scanned: Sent to the sender when a file could not be scanned.
keyDescription.invitation: Sent to the external person invited to deposit.
keyDescription.quota-warning: Sent to the delegated administrators at 80% of the quota.
keyDescription.quota-reached: Sent to the delegated administrators when the quota is reached.
keyDescription.antivirus-unavailable: Sent to the administrators of the entity when the antivirus has not responded for several minutes while transfers are waiting for analysis.
keyDescription.secret-notification: Sent to the recipient of an e-mail secret with the link to read it once.
keyDescription.secret-receipt: Sent to the creator when the secret was read, expired or locked.

editor.title: {template} ({language})

text.hint: Plain text version, read by the mail clients that do not display HTML.

editor.syntax: Variables are written between double braces, for example {example}.

variables.title: Available variables
variables.intro: Click a variable to insert it at the cursor position, in the last field used.
variables.requiredNote: Required variables must appear in the template.

description.validity_minutes: Lifetime of the code, in minutes.
description.inviter_email: Address of the internal user who sends the invitation.
description.message: Message of the sender or of the inviter, quoted; empty when there is none.
description.expiry_date: Date when the unused invitation expires.
description.expiry_datetime: Date and time when the transfer expires.
description.password_notice: Notice that the password comes through another channel; empty without password.
description.confidentiality_notice: Confidentiality level of the transfer; empty when the transfer has no level.
description.reply_notice: Warning that the transfer is a reply from an external sender whose address was verified by a code; empty when it is not a reply.
description.qr_code: QR code of the download link (HTML only; empty in the text body).
description.withheld_files: Files withheld because they could not be scanned; empty when there is none.
description.infected_files: Infected files, deleted, with the detected threat; empty when there is none.
description.problem_summary: Short summary for the subject (infected file deleted, or file withheld).
description.outcome: Whether the other files were sent or the whole transfer was rejected.
description.download_datetime: Date and time of the first complete download.
description.deletion_notice: When the transfer will be erased, or that this notice is sent only once.
description.usage_percent: Share used, with the percent sign, rounded down.
description.threshold_percent: Alert threshold, with the percent sign.
description.total_size: Size of the disk of the data directory.

unknown.one: Unknown variable: {names}. It will not be replaced.
unknown.other: Unknown variables: {names}. They will not be replaced.

serverError.title: The template contains errors
serverError.notSaved: The template was not saved: correct the errors listed below.
serverError.note: The error messages of the server are written in English.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subject: Subject: {subject}
preview.note: This preview shows the structure and content of the email without its styles, with images replaced by their description and links disabled. The email received shows them normally.

reset.confirmText: Your customization of this template in this language will be permanently deleted.
reset.done: The default template has been restored.
reset.reloadFailed: The default template has been restored, but it could not be loaded again: {message}
reset.reloaded: The template has been loaded again.

legal.title: Legal information
legal.intro: Texts shown on the legal information page of the entity, in Markdown, for each language.
legal.caption: Legal documents

editor.title: {document} ({language})

markdown.label: Text (Markdown)
markdown.hint: Headings with #, lists with -, links with [text](address) (https: or mailto: addresses only). HTML is not interpreted.

editor.previewEmpty: No preview: the text is empty.
editor.previewNote: Preview of the saved text. Save to update the preview.

emptyConfirm.title: Delete the document?
emptyConfirm.text: The text is empty: saving it deletes this document, which will no longer be shown on the public pages in this language.

recipientRules.title: Recipient domains
recipientRules.intro: Limit the domains senders can address. Leave both lists empty to allow any recipient. The rules apply to transfers created after saving.

allowed.label: Allowed domains
allowed.hint: One domain per line. When this list is not empty, recipients can only belong to these domains. Subdomains are included: example.org also covers mail.example.org.

denied.label: Denied domains
denied.hint: One domain per line, for example consumer webmail. Subdomains are included. A denied domain is always refused, even when it is also in the allowed list.

warnings.both: {domain} is in both lists: it is denied, because the deny list wins.

restricts.one: The allowed list is not empty: recipients are restricted to this {count} domain.
restricts.other: The allowed list is not empty: recipients are restricted to these {count} domains.

recipientRules.normalized: Some values were rewritten or removed by the server (lowercase, duplicates): the lists now show the saved values.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality levels
confidentiality.intro: Levels the sender chooses from when creating a transfer. Each level imposes its own rules. With a single level, the selector is hidden but its rules still apply. The rules apply to transfers created after saving.

hints.key: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore, starting with a letter (32 characters at most). Identifies the level in the API; keep it stable.
hints.description: Optional. Shown to the sender under the level.
hints.recipientVerification: Takes effect once per-recipient links are available. Until then, the option is stored but not applied.
hints.internalRecipientsOnly: Recipients must belong to the internal domains of the entity.
hints.maxDownloads: Optional, from 1 to {max}. Caps the number of downloads a sender can set; empty for no cap.
hints.linkOnlyAllowed: Lets senders send at this level without any mail to the recipients: the sender passes the link on themselves. Cannot be combined with recipient verification. Has no effect while the entity does not allow link-only transfers.
hints.e2ePolicy: Can only tighten the policy of the entity: with an entity policy of Forbidden or Required, this choice has no effect. Encrypted files are never analysed by the antivirus.

errors.tooMany: There can be at most {max} levels.
errors.keyFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore, starting with a letter (32 characters at most).
errors.keyDuplicate: This key is used by another level.
errors.labelTooLong: The label is too long (at most {max} characters).
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description is too long (at most {max} characters).
errors.capInvalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and {max}, or leave the field empty.

confidentiality.levelInUse: This level is used by an active drop link. Change or revoke that link first ("Drop links" screen), then try again.

e2ePolicy.inherit: Inherit the policy of the entity

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.intro: Lets the delegated admins and auditors of this entity sign in to the administration with the OpenID Connect identity provider of the organisation (for example Microsoft Entra ID). The redirect address to register at the provider is shown in the guide. Super administrators always sign in with their local password and two-factor authentication.
sso.readOnlyIntro: Single sign-on settings of this entity. Only a super administrator can change them.
sso.notConfigured: Single sign-on is not configured for this entity.

enabled.label: Enable single sign-on
enabled.hint: When disabled, the settings are kept but nobody can sign in through them.

issuer.label: Issuer
issuer.hint: Address (https) of the identity provider. For Microsoft Entra ID, use the issuer of your own directory, for example https://<provider>/<directory-id>/v2.0. The multi-tenant endpoints (common, organizations, consumers) are refused.

clientId.label: Client ID
clientId.hint: Identifier of the application registered at the provider.

clientSecret.label: Client secret
clientSecret.hintRequired: Write-only: it is stored encrypted and never shown again.
clientSecret.hintStored: Leave empty to keep the stored secret. Type a new one to replace it.

sso.secretChangeNote: Changing the issuer or the client ID requires typing a new secret: a secret is never carried over to another application or provider.

emailDomains.label: Email domains
emailDomains.hint: One domain per line, 1 to 20, for example entity-a.example.com. An administrator signs in with an address of one of these domains. A domain can be used by one entity only on the whole instance.

requireMfa.label: Require multi-factor authentication
requireMfa.hint: The identity provider must prove a second factor. With Microsoft Entra ID, add the optional authentication methods claim (amr) to the ID token of the application, otherwise every sign-in is refused.

enforced.label: Enforce single sign-on
enforced.hint: Refuses the local password sign-in of the delegated admins and auditors of this entity.
enforced.warning: Enforced: the local password sign-in will be refused for the delegated admins and auditors of this entity, even if single sign-on stops working. Check the test result and a first sign-in before enforcing. Your own super administrator account is not affected.

test.title: Test
test.intro: Checks that the saved issuer answers with a valid discovery document. Nobody is signed in and the secret is not sent.
test.saveFirst: The test uses the saved settings: save your changes first.
test.notSaved: The test cannot run: enable and save the settings first.

errors.dns_error: The provider name could not be resolved.
errors.connect_error: The connection to the provider was refused or reset.
errors.tls_error: The secure connection failed (certificate or protocol).
errors.timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
errors.http_status: The discovery document was not served (unexpected HTTP status).
errors.invalid_document: The discovery document is not valid.
errors.issuer_mismatch: The discovery document names another issuer.
errors.missing_endpoint: An endpoint is missing or is not served over https.

remove.title: Remove single sign-on
remove.text: Removes the settings, the stored secret and the routing of the email domains. Pinned identities stay but become unusable, and accounts created without an activation link cannot sign in until single sign-on is configured again.
remove.confirmText: The administrators of this entity who sign in through single sign-on will no longer be able to sign in. This cannot be undone.

errors.issuerHttps: The issuer must be an https address.
errors.secretRequired: Type the client secret: it is required for the first save and whenever the issuer or the client ID changes.
errors.domainsRequired: Enter at least one email domain.

import.title: Import a configuration
import.intro: Creates an entity from an exported configuration. Enter the name, the address (FQDN) and the storage quota; everything else comes from the configuration. The entity is created in the setup state.
import.introDuplicate: The configuration of the entity {name} (logo and background image included) is used to create a new entity. Enter its name, its address (FQDN) and its storage quota.
import.loadError: The configuration to duplicate could not be loaded.
import.webhooks: The file mentions {count} webhook(s): they are not recreated, enter them again in the entity after the import.

file.label: Configuration file (JSON)
file.hint: File exported from an entity, 32 MB at most.

errors.too-large: This file is larger than 32 MB: it is not an exported configuration.
errors.not-json: This file is not valid JSON.
errors.not-an-object: This file does not hold an entity configuration (a JSON object is expected).
errors.required: Choose the configuration file to import.
errors.unreadable: This file could not be read.
